verdict.rationale: Flagright's docs describe first-party webhooks that push real-time HTTPS JSON notifications. A single endpoint can subscribe to multiple events, with retries for up to 3 days, signed `X-Flagright-Signature` headers, and secret rotation from the Console. That covers registrable outbound callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive and verify. Missing for 10: a full event-type catalog (only SAR events are shown), evidence of registering endpoints via API rather than the Console, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A webhook enables Flagright to push real-time notifications to your app. Flagright uses HTTPS to send these notifications to your app as a JSON payload.
You can subscribe to multiple events in a single webhook endpoint.
Flagright webhooks have built-in retry methods for 3xx, 4xx, or 5xx response status codes. We will retry for up to 3 days
Flagright signs the webhook events it sends to your endpoints by including a signature in each event's `X-Flagright-Signature` header.
